title: Team Grid
description: The people page in one block: six members with avatars, roles and a one-line bio each.
usage: Avatars are the Avatar part with initials — swap in photographs by replacing the span with an img inside the same class. Six is the grid’s natural size; for four or eight, the columns adapt. Keep the one-line bios specific: "Runs the night shift" beats "Passionate innovator" everywhere on Earth.
